title: lint: validate-dataset-measure-aggregates keeps a private copy of the aggregate-pair declaration reading that aggregate-pair-verdict.ts now owns (#32449 follow-up)
body:
domain:spec#4 · marchtian · session_017ihL2gENvvRYHmL5nFTF5x

Filing gate: ③ cleanup, reported by the #32449 card thread in PR #32502 (os-dev-report 6812271120, out_of_scope_findings 2; contract review round 3 nit). ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade.
Reader: `domain:spec`, `packages/lint/src/validate-dataset-measure-aggregates.ts` (`declaredAs`, line ~365, and its own reading of the field's declaration).
Dedupe: `is:issue is:open validate-dataset-measure-aggregates` → 3 hits, none on this (#32449, seat posts).
reach: no behaviour today. PR #32502 adds `packages/lint/src/aggregate-pair-verdict.ts`, the one verdict and remedy for an aggregate × field pair that the list-view and grid members share. The dataset-measure member still carries its private twin of the same declaration reading (`aggregateAcceptsDeclaration` / `declaredAs`), so a later table change can make the three surfaces disagree.
Blocked-by: #32449

## Ask

Import the shared verdict and delete the twin. The existing dataset-measure pins must stay green unchanged; if any message moves, say so. No contract change: `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: unchanged`.
